title: Steins;Gate
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In Akihabara in 2010, self-styled mad scientist Rintaro Okabe and his friends discover that their microwave-phone invention can send text messages into the past. Their experiments shift timelines and draw the attention of SERN, an organization pursuing time travel, and Okabe relives repeated deaths of his friends while trying to find a timeline where both Mayuri and Kurisu survive. This three-volume manga by Yomi Sarachi adapts the visual novel.
life_message: Choices have consequences you must accept, and love means bearing great cost to protect friends.
